faults.page says: In the 2005 statutes of the Institut de Cultura de Barcelona, article 27 is the annual accounts; the council approval of budget, credit operations and property disposals is article 28 (staff is article 18, contracting article 21)
faults.fix: A Barcelona city gazette agreement says the Institut de Cultura de Barcelona programmes La Virreina, and the Institute's 2005 statutes (articles 18, 21 and 28) set staff, contracting, and council approval of budget, credit operations and property disposals.
